rotation.note: Operator override: FULL movies keyword set used as seeds (3 core + all 23 list keywords), not a date-rotated slice. Date rotation (day-of-month 19) is applied only to EMPHASIS and ORDER: the query list starts at list index 19 mod 23 -> 'Luma film' and wraps, and within that order the craft/creative angles NOT covered in the last 10 days (screenwriting, likeness/deepfake, trailer & marketing, restoration, animation, scene generation, previs, short-film circuit) lead ahead of the post/NLE-assistant and Hollywood-policy angles that have dominated the deck since IBC. YouTube creator subset starts at index 19 mod 5 = 4 -> fxguide, then Runway, Corridor Crew, Curious Refuge, Matt Wolfe.

retrieval_hint.why: Plain `site:` WebSearch returns stale evergreen pages for these trade outlets; the published_time gate then kills most of them. Harvest each domain's RSS/Atom/news-sitemap first, keep items whose pubDate falls inside the 336h (14-day) window, and only then use WebSearch queries to fill gaps.
retrieval_hint.youtube_feed_pattern: https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=<UC...> — resolve channel_id by fetching https://www.youtube.com/@<handle> and reading `channelId` / `og:url` in the HTML. The ?user=<name> form only works for legacy accounts.
retrieval_hint.note: IBC 2026 / TIFF product-news wave is now ~10 days old and the deck is saturated with NLE-assistant and shared-storage stories. Push harder on the creative-craft feeds this run: fxguide, befores & afters, VFX Voice, Cartoon Brew, Animation Magazine, AWN, ASC, Motionographer — plus Variety/THR/IndieWire/Deadline for deals, likeness and guild news.
